title: Sarsfield
html_source: Patrick Sarsfield, Earl of Lucan, was a renowned military leader who signed the Treaty of Limerick for the Irish before leading the Wild Geese to fame in battle on continental Europe, where he died at the Battle of Landen. Reportedly, his dying words were “Would that this was for Ireland.”
